title: A and An
introduction: Practise a and an with familiar words and short sentences.
definition: Use a or an before a single countable thing when it is not already identified. Choose by the next sound.
rules: Use a before a consonant sound: a book.
Use an before a vowel sound: an apple.

examples.question: ___ apple
steps: Use a before a consonant sound: a book.

examples.question: ___ pencil
steps: Use an before a vowel sound: an apple.

summary: Use a or an before a single countable thing when it is not already identified. Choose by the next sound.
